source_clause: ICE1.) Whenever changes to the climate system are made via hard controls or touchscreen, these changes are reflected in both locations with the exception of the recirculation led in climate off (see ICE11.). Whenever fan speed or temperature hard controls are used (even if at highest/lowest setting), according pop-ups are shown if NOT on climate screen (timeout after 3 sec), and changes are reflected in status bar/ status indicator on category button. When sync'd, do not show slider pop-up on passenger side when adjusting driver slider. If the user is outside of the climate main category and the temperature is changed through hard controls, a pop-up will be shown coming down from that temperature in the status bar to indicate it is being altered, for ATC it will display the degree (or half degree increments for Celsius) being set, for MTC it will display a slider bar with the arrow pointing to the current setting, this information will change as the user alters the temp. If on climate screen, status changes are indicated directly on touchscreen buttons / status indicator on category button and will not be shown in the status bar. If changes are made on climate screen, LEDs on hard controls reflect new status.
reasoning: 驗證目標：16.2（ICE1）以六句定出 EMEA ICS 介面之狀態同步與 popup 規則，九個 037 leaf 逐句對應，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）；九者之可觀察量刻意互斥 —— `-01` 驗硬鍵→觸控之反映、`-08` 驗畫面上之狀態呈現且不入 status bar、`-09` 驗觸控→硬鍵 LED 之反向，三者若共用同一組觀察即違 §4.5。關鍵情境條件：**本批為 ch16 側，EMEA 軸取正向值而非排除式**（`PC_EMEA`，出處 16.2）—— ch2 之 TC 寫「不是 EMEA ICS 車」，ch16 之 TC 寫「是」，同一事實之兩面；依 **R-C34**，第十三軸（3 旋鈕 ICS）**全數補**，其出處為 **2.14 C15** 之「For MTC **with ICS** … 3 knob HVAC controls … no HVAC screens and no HVAC pop ups」—— 該句寫在 ch2 而所治者正是 ICS 車，故 ch16 之 TC 反而更須補之（跨節取據，R-C29，2.14 併入 spec_ref）；第九軸僅 `-01`／`-02`／`-08` 補（可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section），`-03`～`-07` 之可觀察量為 comfort popup，正是 6.3 之例外，`-09` 之可觀察量為硬鍵 LED，皆不補；第十二軸不補 —— ch16 十八節無任何 tab 條文，2.1 屬另一套介面，援引即為跨介面移植。為什麼這樣切：`-06`／`-07` 為第一軸（ATC／MTC）之兩個值，同一 popup 之兩種呈現，故各自成條並於 PC 具名該值。刻意略過：**鏡射表反向使用之結果** —— C1 之「for MTC (**if the MTC has a Climate screen**)」括號限定於 ICE1 不存在，**不得移植**；ICE1 之「with the exception of the recirculation led in climate off (see ICE11.)」則為 ch16 獨有，即 `-02` 之 leaf，惟其指向之 **ICE11 為 16.12（氣流模式），不含 recirculation LED 之規則**（該規則在 ICE9／16.10），**係條文之誤引**，已登 A-CF25；本條僅驗 ICE1 自身所述之例外（畫面不反映該變更），不驗 16.10 之 LED 規則（§8.2.1）。

distinguishing_axis.axis: 節之主題（ICS 畫面解剖 vs ICS 溫度控制）—— 惟其一對 TC 為嚴格等價
distinguishing_axis.delta: `16.2`（ICE1）之主題為 ICS climate 畫面之組成與其元素，`16.6`（ICE5）之主題為溫度之控制與呈現。**兩節各有一 leaf 述同一件事**：`106-04` 與 `110-06` 之 `test_item`／`test_procedure`／`expected_result` **與 `pre_conditions` 皆相同**（僅 PC 行序不同），即**同一台車上要跑兩次一模一樣的測試**。**§10.6 四項全同 → 嚴格等價**，惟 `duplicate_of` **不填** —— 該欄為節級（宣稱整節重複，為假）而此處為條級；037 之兩個 leaf 各自存在，§8.2.2 禁本層合併 leaf。已登 **DR #42**，並記於 pending_sibling 之 `equivalent_tc_pairs`。**本對與跨第九軸之等價對不同**：那些兩側互斥（同一車不可能既 ICS 又非 ICS），本對兩側**同章同軸值**，故重複是實在的

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: ICS climate screen／status bar／category button／comfort popup／硬鍵 LED
interface_axis_review.axis_9: `-082`／`-083`／`-089` 暴露（可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section）→ 補；`-084`～`-088` 之可觀察量為 comfort popup（6.3 之明文例外）、`-090` 為硬鍵 LED，皆不暴露
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— ch16 十八節無任何 tab 條文；2.1 屬 ch2 介面，援引即跨介面移植
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補。出處為 2.14 C15「For MTC **with ICS** … 3 knob HVAC controls … no HVAC screens and no HVAC pop ups」—— 該句寫在 ch2 而所治者正是 ICS 車（跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不適用（反向）** —— 本節即 EMEA ICS 介面本身，故取**正向**軸值 PC「The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle (16.2)」而非排除式；R-C36-1 之逐條問句於 ch16 側之對應問題為「本條於非 EMEA 車輛上有無對象」，答為無，故正向 PC 必要

tcs.tc_title: Hard control changes are reflected on the ICS climate screen
tcs.test_item: Whenever changes to the climate system are made via hard controls or touchscreen, these changes shall be reflected in both locations
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the current fan speed
2. The climate screen shows the new fan speed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Recirculation LED change is not reflected while climate is off
tcs.test_item: Changes shall be reflected in both locations with the exception of the recirculation LED in climate off
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the climate system off using the climate power button on the climate screen
2. Press the recirculation hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CLIMATE OFF screen is displayed
2. The climate screen does not reflect the recirculation change
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Fan pop-up appears off the climate screen and times out
tcs.test_item: According pop-ups shall be shown if NOT on climate screen (timeout after 3 sec)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open a screen other than the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control
3. Wait 3 seconds without further interaction
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is not displayed
2. A fan speed pop-up is shown
3. The fan speed pop-up is no longer shown
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: No passenger slider pop-up while synced
tcs.test_item: When sync'd, the system shall not show the slider pop-up on the passenger side when adjusting the driver slider
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a single zone climate configuration, for which Sync is not shown (16.11)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn SYNC on from the climate screen
2. Adjust the driver temperature slider
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "SYNC" button is highlighted
2. No slider pop-up is shown on the passenger side
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Temperature pop-up comes down from the status bar
tcs.test_item: If the user is outside of the climate main category and the temperature is changed through hard controls, a pop-up shall be shown coming down from that temperature in the status bar
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open a screen outside the climate main category
2. Change the temperature using the temperature hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate main category is not displayed
2. A pop-up comes down from the temperature in the status bar
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: ATC pop-up displays the degree being set
tcs.test_item: For ATC the pop-up shall display the degree (or half degree increments for Celsius) being set
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle has an ATC climate system (16.2)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the temperature units to Celsius and open a screen outside the climate main category
2. Change the temperature using the temperature hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate main category is not displayed
2. The pop-up displays the degree being set in half degree increments
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: MTC pop-up displays a slider bar with an arrow
tcs.test_item: For MTC the pop-up shall display a slider bar with the arrow pointing to the current setting
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle has an MTC climate system (16.2)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open a screen outside the climate main category
2. Change the temperature using the temperature hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate main category is not displayed
2. The pop-up displays a slider bar with the arrow pointing to the current setting
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: On the climate screen status is not shown in the status bar
tcs.test_item: If on climate screen, status changes shall be indicated directly on touchscreen buttons and on the status indicator on the category button, and shall not be shown in the status bar
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed using the fan speed control on the climate screen
3. Read the status bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is displayed
2. The touchscreen button and the status indicator on the category button show the new fan speed
3. The status bar does not show the fan speed change
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Hard control LEDs follow changes made on the screen
tcs.test_item: If changes are made on climate screen, LEDs on hard controls shall reflect the new status
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the fan speed LED on the hard controls
2. Change the fan speed using the fan speed control on the climate screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The fan speed LED shows the current fan speed
2. The fan speed LED shows the new fan speed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
